clue.text: Savage to devour rook and chicken portion

indicators.note: to devour is to take something inside, so one piece swallows another

parts.note: a savage is a brute or beast
R is the chess abbreviation for rook

explanation.surface: A wild animal swallows a crow and then a piece of chicken.
explanation.definitionFit: The white meat cut from the front of a bird is a standard chicken portion at the butcher's.

clue.text: Energetic man on board one pumped up for event

parts.note: someone energetic is lively or bouncy
a castle (rook) is a chess man on the board

explanation.surface: A lively chess player is fired up for a tournament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man on board' points to a chessman, here the rook, also called a castle.
explanation.definitionFit: An inflatable play structure is blown up with air for fairs and parties, so it is pumped up for an event.

clue.text: European nudist drinking gallons — one to push the boat out?

definitions.text: one to push the boat out?

indicators.note: drinking takes something in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a nudist goes bare
a Pole is a European from Poland

explanation.surface: A naturist from the Continent is drinking heavily, ready to celebrate lavishly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Push the boat out' is a British idiom for celebrating lavishly; read literally, it describes the long pole used to shove a barge along.
explanation.definitionFit: A long pole used to propel a flat-bottomed river boat literally pushes the vessel along.

clue.text: Concert in timeless African port going ahead

indicators.note: timeless means without T, the abbreviation for time

parts.note: Tunis is the port capital of Tunisia
something going ahead is on

explanation.surface: A concert in a North African city is going ahead after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in concert means acting together in agreement, the same sense as acting as one voice.

clue.text: What Tweeters do to have negative effect on originator?

definitions.meaning: tweeters are birds, which fly back to their perches at night
an idiom for bad deeds rebounding on the person who did them

explanation.surface: Twitter users find their posts backfire on them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tweeters' suggests social-media users, but here they are simply birds.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom says that wrongdoing eventually rebounds upon its perpetrator, just as birds return to their perches.

clue.text: Satellite first going between rings?

indicators.note: going between puts this piece into the middle of the other

parts.note: two kinds of ring: CALL (a ring on the phone) and O (a ring shape)
1ST, written IST, is an abbreviation for first

explanation.surface: A satellite is the first thing to pass through a planet's rings.
explanation.walkthrough: One word, 'rings', does double duty for a phone call and a circle shape; 1ST is written with I for the digit.
explanation.definitionFit: This is one of the four large Galilean moons of Jupiter, a natural satellite.

clue.text: Huss cooked with one fish dish

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are prepared and changed into something new

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Huss, a fish sold in British chip shops, is cooked with another fish.
explanation.walkthrough: Huss is a British fishmonger's name for dogfish.
explanation.definitionFit: This Japanese preparation of vinegared rice is often topped with raw fish, a well-known fish dish.

clue.text: Loyal follower — bloke from Belgian city?

indicators.note: a bloke from a place comes after its name, as in Paris man

parts.note: Liège is a city in eastern Belgium
a bloke is a man

explanation.surface: A devoted supporter is a fellow from a city in Belgium.
explanation.definitionFit: In feudal times a vassal bound to serve his lord was his faithful follower.

clue.text: Song Frau von Trapp won't start

indicators.note: won't start means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: Maria von Trapp is the heroine of The Sound of Music

explanation.surface: The Sound of Music heroine refuses to begin singing.
explanation.definitionFit: An operatic solo piece for one voice is a kind of song.

clue.text: Dark treacle in short while found by girls

indicators.note: found by places one piece next to the other

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a short while
lasses are girls

explanation.surface: Some girls quickly discover a tin of black syrup.
explanation.definitionFit: This thick dark syrup from sugar refining is what Americans call the treacle Britons know.

clue.text: Gifts bestowed in important letter read out?

indicators.note: read out signals that the words are spoken

parts.note: a large S is a big, important-looking letter

explanation.surface: Presents are announced in a letter of great importance.
explanation.definitionFit: Generosity in giving money or gifts, or the gifts themselves, is the sense here.

clue.text: I'm about to stay in the same place

indicators.note: about puts one piece around the other

parts.note: taken as written, without the apostrophe
to bide is to stay or wait

explanation.surface: Someone announces they are about to stay where they are.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About to' reads as 'going to', but 'about' is the containment signal and 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: This Latin word used in footnotes literally means in that very place, citing the source just named.

clue.text: Amazing sunspot due to explode

indicators.note: exploding breaks these words apart so their letters reform

explanation.surface: A sunspot is about to blow up spectacularly.
explanation.definitionFit: Something astonishing or prodigious is a synonym for amazing.

clue.text: Colossus inspiring current painter

indicators.note: inspiring literally means breathing in, so one piece takes in another

parts.note: a colossus is a giant or titan
I is the physics symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A giant figure stimulates a modern artist.
explanation.definitionFit: The Venetian Renaissance master Tiziano Vecellio is a famous painter.

clue.text: Inflammation of a certain spot? That can't be helped!

parts.note: there means in that particular place
the medical suffix -itis means inflammation

explanation.surface: A doctor shrugs that a swelling in one place is incurable.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a resigned acceptance that a situation cannot be changed.

clue.text: Cherish and adore D. H. Lawrence, initially slammed

indicators.note: slammed, as in crashed together, shakes the letters into new order

parts.note: the two initials taken as written

indicators.note: initially picks out the first letter of the name

explanation.surface: Someone loves the novelist D. H. Lawrence, though at first critics savaged him.
explanation.definitionFit: To treasure something greatly is to value it highly, the idiom's sense.

clue.text: Firm embracing socialist principles

indicators.note: embracing means holding something inside

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
a red is a socialist or communist

explanation.surface: A company adopts left-wing values.
explanation.definitionFit: A statement of beliefs or creed is a set of guiding principles.

clue.text: Vicious gatekeeper who found employment in Barking?

definitions.text: Vicious gatekeeper who found employment in Barking?

parts.words: Vicious gatekeeper who found employment in Barking?
parts.note: Barking looks like the London district, but means barking as a dog does: the three-headed hound guarding the gates of Hades

explanation.surface: A fierce security guard got a job in Barking, a district of east London.
explanation.definitionFit: The monstrous multi-headed dog of Greek myth guarded the entrance to the underworld, a gatekeeper whose work was barking.

clue.text: Dad! Look at muscular mariner!

parts.note: pop is a word for father
to eye is to look at

explanation.surface: A child calls to their father to look at a brawny sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: The spinach-eating cartoon sailor with bulging forearms is a famously muscular mariner.

clue.text: Go for replanted forest where domestic growth high?

indicators.note: replanted means set again in a new arrangement

parts.note: Arden is the forest of As You Like It

explanation.surface: Choose to restock a woodland with trees in a high spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Replanted forest' seems one unit, but 'replanted' works on 'Go for' and 'forest' is Arden.
explanation.definitionFit: A planted area on top of a house puts household greenery up high.

clue.text: The fat of the land, do we hear?

indicators.note: do we hear signals that the word is spoken

parts.note: the land here is a country, Greece

explanation.surface: Echoes the phrase 'the fat of the land', meaning the best of everything.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal fat melted down or cooking fat is called by this word.

clue.text: Old disciple beheaded in diocese

parts.note: ex means former or old

indicators.note: beheaded means the first letter is cut off

parts.note: Peter was one of Jesus's disciples

explanation.surface: A former apostle lost his head in a bishop's area.
explanation.definitionFit: The Devon cathedral city gives its name to a Church of England see, a diocese.

clue.text: Occasional work for Bond henchman

definitions.meaning: a casual small task done now and then

explanation.surface: A villain's sidekick takes part-time jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: A small casual task is the common sense; the second is Goldfinger's hat-throwing heavy.

clue.text: Boat son consigns to scrapheap

parts.note: a junk is a Chinese sailing boat

explanation.surface: A boy throws away a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To discard something as rubbish is to throw it on the scrapheap.

clue.text: Unbalanced indeed and so this?

indicators.note: unbalanced suggests the letters are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: A speaker remarks that something is truly lopsided and asks if this is too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unbalanced' is both the anagram signal for INDEED SO and, with the whole clue, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A biased or lopsided view favours only one party, so it is unbalanced.

clue.text: Energy fuelling crazed Orlando genius

indicators.note: fuelling means going into something, so it is placed inside
crazed suggests the letters are jumbled

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Energy drives a deranged Orlando, a person of brilliance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fuelling' puts E inside LONARDO, the anagram of ORLANDO from 'crazed'.
explanation.definitionFit: Da Vinci, the Renaissance polymath, is the archetypal universal genius.

clue.text: Some excitement for couple

indicators.note: some means a part of the next word, its letters sitting inside it

explanation.surface: A little thrill for a pair.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people in a relationship are informally called an item, a couple.

clue.text: Compilers from Connaught: their best friends?

definitions.meaning: crossword setters from an Irish province; Connaught is one of the four provinces of Ireland
a dog is man's best friend, and this red breed belongs to the Irish

explanation.surface: Puzzle-makers from western Ireland have dogs as companions.
explanation.definitionFit: This red gundog breed hails from Ireland, and dogs are proverbially humanity's best friends.
